Traffic Advisory 

In view of the rising water level of the Yamuna River, traffic movement is heavily affected on Outer Ring Road from Majnu Ka Tila till Salimgarh By-Pass. Diversions will be in place from Wazirabad–Signature Bridge and Chandgi Ram Akhada–IP College Red Light.

Commuters are advised to avoid these stretches, use alternate routes, avoid roadside parking, and follow directions of traffic personnel for smooth movement.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

⚠️Traffic Advisory⚠️

Ontdekkers Road in Claremont and Delarey is currently barricaded off to traffic with rocks and burning tyres between 10th and 14th Street due to ongoing protest action by residents. 

It is understood that residents are protesting over prolonged water outages in the area. 

JMPD officers are currently monitoring the protest. The situation is calm despite the closure, and motorists are advised to exercise caution, avoid and use alternative routes such as Mollie Road. #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic #SaferJoburg

[2:42PM] #LagosBadagryExp #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic flow remains smooth across major routes. Movement from Agbara Customs Checkpoint through Federal Government College, Ijanikin is clear. The stretch from FRSC Office inward Iyana Era, connecting Iyana Isashi down to Afromedia, is equally free-flowing.

A seamless drive is observed from Afromedia to Iyana Iba and Volks, while both the Iyana Iba flyover inward Mile 2 and the route underneath the flyover toward Igando are moving well. Vehicular movement from Volks through Barracks to Abule Ado, on both the service lane and main carriageway, is also better at this time.

Currently, no impediments reported, with our officers on ground effectively managing traffic flow.
